♉ The Taurus Cloth. OFFENSE

Signature Technique

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Great Horn]

Cloth Passive — Bulwark

You cannot be moved by anything your size or smaller. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks and to your Difficulty Class against attempts to Shove, Trip, Grapple, or Disarm you.

Ascendant Boon — The Great Horn [OFFENSE]

Your unarmed Strikes gain +1 damage die, and a creature you hit must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC; on a failure it is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

You count as one size larger whenever doing so is to your benefit.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Taurus)]

Zenith Boon — The Great Horn (Zenith) [OFFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon, but your unarmed Strikes gain +2 damage dice in total.

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level at the start of each of your turns, and once per round you may cast @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Great Horn] without spending a Focus Point.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Taurus)]

11th-Level Cloth Ability — Titan's Stance

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Titan's Stance]

rules.text: You cannot be moved by anything your size or smaller, and your DC against Shove, Trip, Grapple, and Disarm is 2 higher.
